nom: COSRX Snail Mucin Sheet Mask 10 EA with Snail Mucin Serum

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin consistently report strong relief, including one whose chlorine-stressed skin recovered overnight and another whose winter dryness responded better to this than other hydrating products she'd tried.
segments.combination: The one reviewer with sensitive combination skin reports the mask caused no disruption at all and left her skin smooth and hydrated.
segments.sensitive: Most self-described sensitive-skin reviewers report no irritation, describing the mask as soothing even for reactive skin, but one reviewer with easily irritated skin reports an allergic reaction after a single use and warns the formula may be too aggressive for sensitive skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 50s and 60s generally report visible plumping, reduced redness, and softened fine lines after just one use, though one reviewer in her late 60s saw no noticeable difference after two uses.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers in their late 50s and 60s report softened fine lines, reduced crepiness, and a plumper look after use, including one who documented reduced redness and dryness around her eyes; one reviewer of similar age, however, saw no visible difference after two uses.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers describe this as one of the most hydrating products they've used, with skin looking plump and dewy the next morning; one reviewer, however, felt the essence just sat on top of her skin and didn't absorb, leaving no fresh or hydrated feeling.
concerns.redness: One reviewer documents visibly reduced redness on her forehead after one use, but another reviewer with easily irritated skin reports an allergic reaction to the formula.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports a single use noticeably improved breakouts caused by wearing face coverings; the sheet mask is also described in general terms as suitable for treating acne-prone skin.

aspects.libelle: Fragrance-free with little to no scent

extraits.texte: DECEPTIVE SELLER! Ingredients list in product description is different from the ingredients list in the product received (see pics). The listing leads the buyer to believe that snail mucin is the main (first) ingredient, but that is not the case - it is the actually the 4th ingredient, diluted by water, butylene glycol, and glycerin. Seller needs to update the ingredients list in the listing to accurately reflect what is in the product. This mask is slimy (as expected) but this formulation sits on top of your skin, leaving a sticky, tacky feeling for about an hour after peeling off the face sheet. I don't think it absorbed but rather just dried on the skin surface and did not leave a fresh, hydrated feeling on my skin.

Solo bastó con usar una sola marcarilla para tener esta reacción, nunca tengo problemas de acné , pero si tengo una piel que sufro de irritaciones a fórmulas fuertes, entonces tuve una reacción alérgica quizás a este formula. yo creo que si tienes una piel que se irrita fácil como la mía está mascarilla será muy agresiva para tu piel.

I love Cosrx snail products so I was excited to try this. It smells amazing when I first opened it. It is very nicely saturated and lays on the skin very easily. After 25 min I removed it and pat on the remaining serum on my arms. Feels very smooth and hydrating. Did not disturb my sensitive combination skin at all. Overall, it's a great choice for face masks from a higher end Korean skin care brand. Highly recommended.

I am in the fence with these. It is difficult to get these masks out and unfold to fit face. I am on my second one and nothing earth shattering. Honestly I don’t know what the difference is between these and any other sheet masks. Doubt I will purchase again unless I see major change in my skin. I am almost 68 and expect to see some difference but have not as of this writing.

extraits.titre: Really impressive mask! Good for mature skin.
extraits.texte: I have used far more expensive facial masks similar to this one (with the exception of no snail mucin) and haven’t had nearly the great results as I had with this after one use. I’m 58 and although I have taken good care of my skin, I’m still fighting fine lines and crepey skin especially around my eyes as well as redness and fine lines which are more pronounced in cold weather. I attached two images to show how effective this mask was in the areas of my concern: around eyes, eyelids, and you can see the redness in the first photo on my forehead, as well as general dryness (obviously there is no filter on these). Here’s a few tips: Yes it can be challenging to get the mask out at first, but if you leave the packaging standing upright it helps keep the contents from dripping out. I found the mask to be a bit large near my hairline so using small fabric scissors I cut two pieces out in a half mood shape (it’s easy because the “moon” of the half moon is already there at the top of the mask). I used these small pieces on my eyelids (but was careful not to get any product in my eyes). I also cut slits into the mask near my inner eyes and any areas that gapped so it would lie flat. What I liked: pretty decent results after one use especially on mature skin. Enough serum left in packaging so you can carefully refold the mask, return it to the package, fold the edges over and secure with some paper clips and store in the fridge (note: I sanitized my face and hands so I could re use t

These masks are super slimy but are totally worth it! Putting a sheet full of slime on your face isn't the most appealing thing to do but the amount of moisture and healing it provides is sooo worth it. I've been breaking out alot since having to wear protective coverings on my face all day and just one application of this mask showed major improvement OVER NIGHT! It also moisturized my dry skin. I'm excited to see what long term use can do for my skin! Highly recommend.

extraits.titre: Basically an IV drip for your face
extraits.texte: These masks are incredible. They make my skin feel so glowy, plump, and deeply moisturized the next day. I struggle with dry skin at times, and this instantly brings relief. One time I had a full pool day and came home with tight, dry, chlorine-stressed skin, and this mask literally fixed it overnight. It’s soothing, cooling, and gives me that glass-skin glow I crave. Perfect for a self-care night or skin emergency. I always keep these stocked- they’re that good!
